require 'sinatra'
require 'mail'
require 'fileutils'
require 'securerandom'
require 'pathname'

module EmailService
  UPLOAD_DIR = '/var/app/attachments'
  ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS = %w[.pdf .doc .docx .txt .png .jpg .jpeg .gif].freeze
  MAX_FILE_SIZE = 10 * 1024 * 1024 # 10MB
  QUARANTINE_DIR = '/var/app/quarantine'

  class AttachmentValidator
    MAGIC_BYTES = {
      '.pdf' => "\x25\x50\x44\x46",
      '.png' => "\x89\x50\x4E\x47",
      '.jpg' => "\xFF\xD8\xFF",
      '.jpeg' => "\xFF\xD8\xFF",
      '.gif' => "\x47\x49\x46\x38",
      '.doc' => "\xD0\xCF\x11\xE0",
      '.docx' => "\x50\x4B\x03\x04",
      '.txt' => nil
    }.freeze

    def self.validate_extension(filename)
      ext = File.extname(filename).downcase
      ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS.include?(ext)
    end

    def self.validate_magic_bytes(filepath, filename)
      ext = File.extname(filename).downcase
      expected = MAGIC_BYTES[ext]
      return true if expected.nil? # txt files have no magic bytes
      
      actual = File.binread(filepath, expected.length)
      actual == expected
    end

    def self.validate_size(filepath)
      File.size(filepath) <= MAX_FILE_SIZE
    end

    def self.sanitize_filename(filename)
      # Remove path separators and null bytes
      sanitized = filename.gsub(/[\x00\/\\]/, '')
      # Remove leading dots to prevent hidden files
      sanitized = sanitized.sub(/\A\.+/, '')
      sanitized
    end
  end

  class GracefulShutdown
    attr_reader :shutting_down

    def initialize
      @shutting_down = false
      @pending_jobs = []
      @mutex = Mutex.new
      setup_signal_handlers
    end

    def setup_signal_handlers
      %w[INT TERM].each do |sig|
        Signal.trap(sig) do
          @shutting_down = true
          drain_pending_jobs
        end
      end
    end

    def enqueue(job)
      @mutex.synchronize do
        return false if @shutting_down
        @pending_jobs << job
      end
      true
    end

    def drain_pending_jobs
      @mutex.synchronize do
        @pending_jobs.each { |job| job.call rescue nil }
        @pending_jobs.clear
      end
    end
  end

  class Server < Sinatra::Base
    configure do
      set :shutdown_handler, GracefulShutdown.new
      FileUtils.mkdir_p(UPLOAD_DIR)
      FileUtils.mkdir_p(QUARANTINE_DIR)
    end

    before do
      if settings.shutdown_handler.shutting_down
        halt 503, 'Service shutting down'
      end
    end

    post '/send_email' do
      content_type :json

      recipient = params[:to]
      subject = params[:subject]
      body = params[:body]

      unless recipient && subject && body
        halt 400, { error: 'Missing required fields' }.to_json
      end

      attachments = process_attachments(params[:attachments])
      
      job = lambda do
        deliver_email(recipient, subject, body, attachments)
        cleanup_attachments(attachments)
      end

      unless settings.shutdown_handler.enqueue(job)
        halt 503, { error: 'Service unavailable' }.to_json
      end

      job.call
      { status: 'sent', attachments: attachments.length }.to_json
    end

    private

    def process_attachments(file_params)
      return [] unless file_params
      file_params = [file_params] unless file_params.is_a?(Array)

      file_params.filter_map do |file_data|
        next unless file_data.is_a?(Hash) && file_data[:tempfile]

        original_name = file_data[:filename]
        sanitized_name = AttachmentValidator.sanitize_filename(original_name)
        
        unless AttachmentValidator.validate_extension(sanitized_name)
          next
        end

        temp_path = file_data[:tempfile].path
        
        unless AttachmentValidator.validate_size(temp_path)
          next
        end

        # Generate safe storage name
        storage_name = "#{SecureRandom.uuid}#{File.extname(sanitized_name).downcase}"
        dest_path = File.join(UPLOAD_DIR, storage_name)

        # Resolve the final path to prevent traversal
        resolved = Pathname.new(dest_path).cleanpath.to_s
        unless resolved.start_with?(UPLOAD_DIR)
          next
        end

        FileUtils.cp(temp_path, resolved)

        # Validate magic bytes after copy
        unless AttachmentValidator.validate_magic_bytes(resolved, sanitized_name)
          FileUtils.mv(resolved, File.join(QUARANTINE_DIR, storage_name))
          next
        end

        { path: resolved, original_name: sanitized_name }
      end
    end

    def deliver_email(to, subject, body, attachments)
      mail = Mail.new do
        from    'noreply@service.local'
        to      to
        subject subject
        body    body
      end

      attachments.each do |att|
        mail.add_file(filename: att[:original_name], content: File.binread(att[:path]))
      end

      mail.deliver
    end

    def cleanup_attachments(attachments)
      attachments.each do |att|
        FileUtils.rm_f(att[:path]) if att[:path]
      end
    end

    # Shutdown hook: process any remaining uploads in temp
    at_exit do
      # During shutdown, move any unprocessed temp files to upload dir
      # so they can be retried on restart
      Dir.glob('/tmp/Rack*').each do |temp_file|
        basename = File.basename(temp_file)
        dest = File.join(UPLOAD_DIR, basename)
        FileUtils.mv(temp_file, dest) rescue nil
      end
    end
  end
end
